response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS site_count
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         site_count,
         site_count::numeric / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT site_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(site_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing healtheval is grouped as SQL NULL; its distinct site count contributes to the total count used as the share denominator and to the average across statuses.
